summary: Judged the dead prior attempt's uncommitted tree (a100c/backend/allocate.py, backend/emit.py, lower/vectorize.py, lower/matrix.py, tests -- all inside the a100c-lowering-backend conflict scope) and completed its verification. The three census classes are repaired through the shared paths: (1) ptradd 64-bit scalar offsets widen the vector index lane class (vwiden sext -> legalized vwaddx0 at e64m2) in _sum_offsets/_address_of instead of refusing; (2) the allocator colors LMUL 4/8 groups as naturally aligned register groups inside the 32x128B file with legal full-vl spill (512B slots, offset-safe frame emission past the 12-bit immediate); (3) the non-convergence class converges via constant rematerialization at uses, reload values never re-split, neighbour-targeted victim selection with a recomputed interference graph, and a located refusal naming the pressure source as the bounded fallback. Filtered sweep over the 22 owned operators: the three classes at ZERO -- 69 owned identities now 62 artifacts + 7 located scalar-lowering refusals (a different construct), 69 refused->artifact improvements, 0 regressions among the 79 identities of those operators. I added the missing MECH-WITNESS-TEST controls to test_t029_repairs.py (mixed-LMUL overlap rejection of a forged assignment, remat value preservation, spill/reload slot+shape matching, textual full-vl ambient assertion on emitted spill sites) and probed the spill form's vl semantics on the pinned QEMU (vsetvli x0,x0 KEEPS ambient vl; all 18 spill sites in the owned artifacts sit in full-vl ambient regions, so whole groups move). Fixed one stale pre-existing expectation exposed by the full suite: test_layout_ops.py still expected avg_pool1d_kernel_optimized to refuse on grid provenance, but it compiles since T027's committed gridmodel work -- verified executed+compared PASS at 1/2/4 workers and moved it into the executor census per the file's own convention. Full a100c test suite: 34/35 files pass; the full-corpus compile sweep exits 1 only on inherited blockers outside the owned classes (36 vmath EmissionError rows identical to T028's recorded 36, 3 pre-existing unlocated const rows, 11 over-budget economics rows, none on owned operators) and refreshed the full census (the cumulative corpus state across T024-T028's committed repairs and this task's tree: artifacts 427 -> 1170): ptradd-width and LMUL-4 at zero corpus-wide, non-convergence zero on the owned operators, with one newly exposed located non-convergence refusal on non-owned nanmedian_select that names its pressure source (value 'k288', 32 values live against 25 GPRs) -- the contract's third permitted outcome.
